## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits and are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)
- [ ] Requirement IDs (`FR-…` / `NFR-…`) referenced in commits, docstrings and test names
- [ ] Tests added or updated; `uv run pytest`, `ruff check`, `ruff format --check` and `pyright` pass
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `[Unreleased]` (if user-visible)
- [ ] ADR added in `docs/decisions/` (if a non-trivial decision was made)
